hints.NOT_FOUND: Check the number and its length — the carrier may not have collected the parcel yet.
hints.NEEDS_KEY: Add a lastscanned.com key as LASTSCANNED_API_KEY on Vercel to unlock Logen, FedEx, UPS, USPS, Cainiao, EMS and 551 carriers.
hints.UNSUPPORTED: Supported: CJ Logistics · Korea Post · Hanjin · Lotte · Logen · DHL · FedEx · UPS · USPS · Cainiao · EMS + 550 more worldwide
hints.UPSTREAM: Try again shortly, or check the carrier site directly.
hints.BAD_REQUEST: Hyphens, spaces and symbols are removed automatically.
hints.NETWORK: Check your connection and try again.
hints.AWB_NOT_FOUND: Check the AWB number. If this was a parcel number, pick its carrier and it will be looked up as a parcel.
hints.AIRLINE_BLOCKED: Korean Air requires a browser session for its cargo lookup. Open the airline link below, or try Asiana (988) or a flight number.
hints.AWB_UNSUPPORTED: Only Asiana (988) and Korean Air (180) cargo AWBs are looked up for now.
hints.IS_FLIGHT: Type the flight number in the search box and its aircraft appears on the globe.
hints.FLIGHT_NONE: It may be on the ground or outside radar coverage. Check the flight number or try again shortly.
hints.TIMEOUT: Try again shortly, or check the carrier site directly.
hints.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: Try again shortly, or check the carrier site directly.
